title: Explain/Verify Shutdown Queues Behavior: AGVs in Shutdown State Cycle to Charge, Then Move to Zones
summary: Use the Geek+ RMS walkthrough to confirm that when the system is in the AGV shutdown state, AGVs remain in shutdown logic, cycle through charging, and then—on startup—move into their assigned zones (4 zones referenced).
when_to_use: When you need to interpret/verify the expected AGV behavior during the system shutdown state: AGVs sit in shutdown queues, cycle through charging, and then move into their assigned zones when the system starts up.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Observe the Geek+ RMS walkthrough state/behavior for AGVs in shutdown queues and confirm the expected charging-cycle and zone-movement behavior on startup.
access_or_tools_needed: Geek+ RMS walkthrough view (RMS web page used in the segment)
Any live view used in the RMS walkthrough to observe AGV state/zone assignment (exact UI elements not named in the source)

access_required: Access to the Geek+ RMS web page used for the walkthrough
system_preconditions: System is in shutdown state (not actively sorting parcels; shutdown is described as a transition between sorts)

visual_references.description: Frame from Geek+ RMS walkthrough where shutdown queues are defined and the expected behavior is described (shutdown queues location, cycling through charging, then moving into their zones; 4 zones referenced).

steps.title: Identify the system state being discussed as “shutdown state” (not actively sorting parcels)
steps.purpose: Ensure you are validating the correct operational state (shutdown logic) before checking charging-cycle and zone movement behavior.
steps.instruction: On the Geek+ RMS walkthrough view, confirm you are validating behavior for the shutdown state (described as when the system is not actively sorting parcels and is in a transition between two sorts).
steps.expected_result: You are observing/validating AGV behavior that corresponds to the shutdown state (not the running/bagging-out/close-out sorting phases).
steps.healthy_condition: Shutdown is treated as the state where AGVs are in shutdown logic and are not actively sorting parcels.
steps.failure_condition: You attempt to validate shutdown-queue charging-cycle behavior while the system is actively sorting parcels (running/bagging-out/close-out phases).

actions.label: Confirm shutdown state context
actions.exact_action: Use the Geek+ RMS walkthrough context for the shutdown state (shutdown described as not actively sorting parcels; transition between sorts).

source_evidence.quote: “shutdown is basically when you're not actively sorting parcels and you're, you're in a transition between two sorts.”

steps.title: Verify the meaning of “shutdown queues” as the holding location for AGVs in shutdown state
steps.purpose: Confirm you are checking the correct location/logic: shutdown queues are where AGVs sit when shut down.
steps.instruction: Using the Geek+ RMS walkthrough view, verify that “shutdown queues” correspond to the holding location for AGVs while they are in shutdown state.
steps.expected_result: Shutdown queues are confirmed as the location where AGVs sit when they are shut down.
steps.healthy_condition: AGVs are described/observed as being in shutdown queues while the system is in shutdown state.
steps.failure_condition: AGVs are not observed/behaving as if they are held in shutdown queues during shutdown state.

actions.label: Check shutdown queues definition/behavior
actions.exact_action: Confirm “Shut down queues is just where it sits when it's shut down.”

source_evidence.quote: “Shut down queues is just where it sits when it's shut dow[n].”

steps.title: Observe/confirm shutdown logic: AGVs stay in shutdown logic and cycle through each AGV to charge
steps.purpose: Validate the expected charging-cycle behavior while the system remains in shutdown state.
steps.instruction: On the Geek+ RMS walkthrough view, observe that AGVs remain in shutdown logic and cycle through each AGV to charge them while in shutdown queues/shutdown state.
steps.expected_result: AGVs remain in shutdown logic and you observe them cycling for charging (described as cycling through each of the AGVs to charge them).
steps.healthy_condition: AGVs do not transition into idle/running sorting behavior; instead they cycle through charging while staying in shutdown logic.
steps.failure_condition: AGVs do not remain in shutdown queues/shutdown logic, or they do not cycle through charging as described.

actions.label: Watch charging-cycle behavior in shutdown
actions.exact_action: Confirm the described behavior: “they stay in the shutdown logic and they cycle through each of the AGVs to charge them.”

stop_or_escalate_if: AGVs do not appear to remain in shutdown queues/shutdown logic during shutdown state
AGVs do not cycle through charging while in shutdown state

source_evidence.quote: “So the Agvs are they stay in the shutdown logic and they cycle through each of the Agvs to charge them.”

steps.title: Check startup behavior: AGVs move from shutdown queues into their own zones (4 zones referenced)
steps.purpose: Validate the expected transition on startup: AGVs leave shutdown queues and move into assigned zones.
steps.instruction: On the Geek+ RMS walkthrough view, after startup, confirm that AGVs move from shutdown queues into their assigned zones. Note that the segment references 4 zones.
steps.expected_result: AGVs move from shutdown queues into their own zones after startup; 4 zones are referenced in the segment.
steps.healthy_condition: AGVs are observed in zone locations (idle state described as zones assigned to them) after startup.
steps.failure_condition: After startup, AGVs do not move into their assigned zones (or do not reflect the expected zone behavior described).

actions.label: Verify zone movement after startup
actions.exact_action: Confirm the described behavior: “when they start up, they move into their own zones… Here we have 4 zones.”

stop_or_escalate_if: After startup, AGVs do not move into their assigned zones

source_evidence.quote: “when they start up, they move into their own zones… So here we have 4 zones.”

success_criteria: Shutdown queues are confirmed as the holding location for AGVs in shutdown state
While in shutdown state, AGVs remain in shutdown logic and cycle through charging
On startup, AGVs move from shutdown queues into their assigned zones (4 zones referenced)
healthy_conditions: Shutdown state corresponds to not actively sorting parcels (transition between sorts)
AGVs stay in shutdown logic and cycle through charging

AGVs do not cycle through charging while in shutdown state
After startup, AGVs do not move into their assigned zones
escalation_guidance: Escalate if observed behavior does not match the described shutdown-queue charging cycle and zone movement; the source provides definitions but no specific corrective actions.
